title: AI Foundry Web Search vs Bing Custom Search
subtitle: The same search task and target websites, tested through two implementation paths
limitations: Native source URLs and model answers were not independently checked against downloaded original pages.
Each compliance marker checks only whether the native source host is in the target list. It does not verify relevance, publication date, or factual accuracy.
The site: expression and allowed-site list for ordinary Web Search are prompt-level constraints, not hard domain filtering by the search service.
The local Custom Bing website list comes from demo/custom_bing_search.json. Reconcile it with the Portal if the cloud configuration changes.
The two paths may use different model and Agent system settings, so this demonstration compares source-scope control only.
